evidence: Extensively updates src/util/result.h and adds src/util/messages.h to implement structured error and warning handling.
rationale: Extending util::Result provides shared error-handling infrastructure that simplifies call sites and directly unblocks wallet loading refactoring (#25722) and kernel fatal-error handling (#29700). The PR description notes this is a 'key missing feature that makes the result class not useful for functions like LoadChainstate() which produce different errors that need to be handled differently.'
